$comment: The roadmap canvas's manifest for <Project>: one card per step or group (tools/roadmap-canvas/SPEC.md §2). Only structure lives here; the facts come from the documents, the tags and GitHub when extract.mjs runs.

statusGroups.name: Built, not released
statusGroups.hint: Merged into the integration branch; goes out with the next release.

statusGroups.name: In flight
statusGroups.hint: On a branch with a PR, or being built now.

statusGroups.name: Planned, in order
statusGroups.hint: In the roadmap's order of work, not started.

statusGroups.name: Ongoing
statusGroups.hint: No milestone or gate; each item ships when convenient.

process.summary: How a change travels from the owner's decision to a release, and how the documents record it.

nodes.title: The owner decides
nodes.text: Every decision is recorded once in the plan's decisions section with the next free D-number; superseded ones move to an archive. Defaults a session chose while the owner was away wait in decisions-pending.md.

nodes.title: ROADMAP orders the work
nodes.text: ROADMAP.md holds the open steps in one order with what each delivers and what blocks it. Finished steps move verbatim to the archive.

nodes.title: Sessions build on branches
nodes.text: Each piece of work has a branch; sessions or agents work in their own worktrees and never touch each other's files.

nodes.title: A PR, green
nodes.text: Nothing merges red. CI runs the checks that would catch a user-visible break.

nodes.title: The owner's eye
nodes.text: Acceptance covers only what a user would notice or what would break; the owner judges the rest from what is shown.

nodes.title: Tag <step>-done
nodes.text: A step the owner approves is tagged on its green commit.

nodes.title: Release
nodes.text: The tag is merged into the release branch and deployed; a live check confirms it.

nodes.title: STATUS and the log
nodes.text: STATUS.md is rewritten at every stop; every finish, release or park gets a comment on the Progress log issue; living docs are updated in the same PR.

sideFlows.label: Anything the owner finds that breaks the release gate goes back into the order of work
